name: Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme for ST Students
short_description: Scholarship for ST students studying in eligible government or government-recognized schools.
department: Ministry of Tribal Affairs and State/UT implementing authorities
degree_level: Class IX-X (as supported by the supplied guideline)
stipend_amount: ₹225/month day scholar or ₹525/month hosteller for 10 months, books grant; additional disability allowance as guideline

validation_rules.label: Scheduled Tribe category
validation_rules.expected: Applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribe category in their domicile State/UT.

validation_rules.label: Annual family income
validation_rules.expected: Family income must not exceed ₹2,50,000/year; orphan-supported-by-guardian exemption applies

validation_rules.label: Class studying
validation_rules.expected: Only the classes covered by the supplied guideline

validation_rules.label: School recognition
validation_rules.expected: Government school or school recognized by Government/Central or State Board

validation_rules.label: Other scholarship
validation_rules.expected: Applicant must not receive another scholarship

validation_rules.label: Repeated class
validation_rules.expected: A class is funded only once; no second award for repeating the same class

required_documents.name: Family income certificate
required_documents.description: Income proof; orphan exemption subject to proof

required_documents.name: Student/parent bank and Aadhaar details
required_documents.description: Active scheduled bank account linked with Aadhaar/mobile

selection_notes: The supplied guideline describes renewal from Class IX to Class X after promotion; class-repeat students do not receive the same class award twice.
Guidelines assign application and DBT operation to States/UTs; process and dates require State/UT configuration.
